svg.title: Isochrones by mode from Marco Zero, Recife
svg.desc: Three maps of Recife, one per mode, each shading the areas reached from Marco Zero, in the old centre on the coast, within 10, 20 and 30 minutes. Walking reaches the islands of the centre and the neighbourhoods just across the rivers; cycling reaches Boa Viagem to the south and Olinda to the north; driving, with free-flowing traffic, reaches almost all of the municipality and beyond it within 30 minutes.
